ShapeEngine
Table of Contents

Namespace ShapeEngine.Input

Classes

GamepadDevice

Represents a gamepad input device, providing access to gamepad buttons and axes, state tracking, calibration, and utility methods for gamepad input.

GamepadDeviceManager

Manages multiple GamepadDevice instances, handling connection state, device claiming, releasing, and tracking last used gamepads.

InputAction

Represents an input action, which can be triggered by various input types and devices. Handles state, multi-tap, hold, and axis sensitivity/gravity.

InputActionTree

Represents a sorted collection of InputAction objects, ordered by their execution order and ID. Provides methods for updating and retrieving input actions based on various criteria.

Implements a blocking system for IInputTypes. When an InputAction in this tree is processed and its BlocksInput property is set to true, it blocks the associated IInputTypes from being used by subsequent InputActions in the same update cycle. This ensures that input types are only handled by the first eligible action, preventing conflicts or duplicate processing.

InputActionTreeGroup

Represents a sorted collection of InputActionTree objects. Provides methods for updating and retrieving input action trees based on various criteria.

InputDevice

Represents a generic input device interface for the ShapeEngine input system. Provides methods for device usage tracking, locking, and calibration.

InputDeviceBase

Abstract base class for all input devices in the ShapeEngine input system. Implements comparison based on device processing priority and unique device ID. Includes methods for updating device state, checking if the device is active, and retrieving the device type.

InputDeviceUsageDetectionSettings

Represents the settings for detecting input device usage, including mouse, keyboard, and gamepad.

InputDeviceUsageDetectionSettings.GamepadSettings

Represents the settings used for detecting gamepad input device usage, including thresholds and detection options.

InputDeviceUsageDetectionSettings.KeyboardSettings

Represents the settings used for detecting keyboard input device usage, including thresholds and detection options.

InputDeviceUsageDetectionSettings.MouseSettings

Represents the settings used for detecting mouse input device usage, including thresholds and detection options.

InputEvent

Represents an input event from a keyboard, mouse, or gamepad device.

InputEventHandler

Handles input events and manages listeners for keyboard, mouse, and gamepad input events.

Represents an input type that tracks the delta of the mouse position relative to a target position. Supports deadzone threshold and optional modifier keys.

KeyboardDevice

Represents a keyboard input device, providing access to keyboard buttons, state tracking, character input, and utility methods for keyboard input.

ModifierKeyGamepadButton

Represents a modifier key that is mapped to a gamepad button.

ModifierKeyKeyboardButton

Represents a modifier key that is mapped to a keyboard button.

ModifierKeyMouseButton

Represents a modifier key that is mapped to a mouse button.

ModifierKeySet

A set of modifier keys that are evaluated together based on a specified operator.

MouseDevice

Represents a mouse input device, providing access to mouse buttons, axes, and wheel axes, as well as state tracking and utility methods for mouse input.

ShapeInput

Provides static access to input devices (keyboard, mouse, gamepads) and input state queries. Handles device switching, input state retrieval, and device change events.
